description.en-US: The ISO 4217 alphabetic code: VND, USD, EUR. The regex enforces upper case rather than a sanitizer folding it, because the only sanitizers available are none/html/plaintext and a lower-case code should be rejected rather than quietly rewritten. Immutable, because it is what every amount elsewhere in the system is denominated by; changing it would silently reinterpret money already recorded.
The ISO 4217 numeric code, e.g. 704 for VND. Kept as a string because it is an identifier with significant leading zeros, not a quantity.
What is shown next to an amount: ₫, $, €.

How many fractional digits this currency is quoted to: 0 for VND, 2 for USD, 3 for KWD. This is why money is stored as decimal rather than as an integer count of minor units — the count is a property of the currency, and holding amounts that way would push this number into every caller that reads one.
Whether new transactions may be denominated in this currency. Distinct from archiving: a currency withdrawn from use must remain readable, because amounts already recorded in it still refer to it.
